ABOUT US
Live Payments is one of Australia's leading payment service providers, servicing thousands of businesses across Australia. We continue to innovate our payment solutions and expand our product offering alongside our industry leading strategic partners including Qantas Loyalty and Prospa.
 
ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Live Payments is seeking a mid-senior level Technical Business Analyst who can help implement strategy across this young and fast-growing company. This role is based in Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam, reporting to the Head of Software Development.
 
Core duties include:
Understanding and considering business and technical engineering/IT needs to ensure quality digital products and related operational workflows to meet/exceed the desired business objectives.
Use agentic AI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, documentation, process mapping, and stakeholder communication
Evaluate and recommend where AI agents can automate or improve existing business processes and product workflows
Using data and process modelling tools (including, but not limited to, process mapping, activity diagram, and dataflow modelling) to analyse and translate business requirements into meaningful statements of work that is acceptable to both business and technology stakeholders.
Performing system analysis activities (e.g., “as-is”, “to-be”, gap analysis) to ensure system and data integrity.
Translating business requirements into functional, non-functional, and technical requirements includes business processes, workflow diagrams, use cases, user experience, and system access.
Participating in system and application architecture design and evaluating solutions against business requirements.
Providing support in testing activities, reviewing test cases and results, organising reviews, tracking feedback, and facilitating UAT when needed.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
University Degree Qualified in a Tech or Business field.
4 years’ experience working in similar roles.
Experience working in the payment and financial service industry is advantageous.
Proficiency in English
 
KEY SKILLS
Superior ability to translate business requirements into functional, non-functional, and technical requirements.
Demonstrated experience using agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, AI-powered analysis tools) as a productivity multiplier — not limited to basic AI chat 
Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and completeness in a business context
Solid presentation, communication, and technical writing skills, with the ability to convey simple and complex information to technical and non-technical audiences at any level.
Solid analytical, system thinking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
Excellent English skills in writing, reading, speaking, and listening.
Adaptable, fast learner and proactive.
 
Nice-to-have Skills
Understanding of Agile and experience working in Agile-driven environments.
Understanding the product development process, having a sense of product ownership and being passionate about building great products.
Experienced in working with various aspects of technology solutions (e.g., user interfaces, mobility, API, databases, system integration) and dealing with technology specialists
